versions.content: signature of a RunnableEntity depends on the connected RTEEvent The signature of a RunnableEntity depends on the connected RTEEvent . Multiple OperationInvokedEvent s that trigger the same RunnableEntity are only supported if all referenced ClientServerOperation s would result in the same RunnableEntity signature for the server RunnableEntity .

signature of a RunnableEntity depends on the connected RTEEvent and the existence of RunnableEntity.argument The signature of a RunnableEntity depends on the connected RTEEvent and the existence of RunnableEntity.argument . Multiple OperationInvokedEvent s that trigger the same RunnableEntity are only supported if either • the server RunnableEntity does not aggregate argument s and all referenced ClientServerOperation s result in the same RunnableEntity signature or • the server RunnableEntity aggregates argument s and all RunnableEn- tity.argument s are compatible to the respective ClientServerOpera- tion.argument s according to [constr_10670].
